course_name_en: Car Body Development and Lightweight Construction
prerequisites: Knowledge of mechanics, strength of materials, kinetics, and kinematics

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the structure of a vehicle car body in its different variants and designs. They are also able to apply and implement lightweight construction principles in design.
Students have the necessary knowledge for the development of vehicle car bodies and are able to consider the aspect of lightweight construction.

Students are able to evaluate the structure and components of a car body and its lightweight potential, and implement them independently. They recognize the complex relationships between the structural components of a car body, the approaches for lightweight optimization, and can explain them. In addition, students apply subject-specific skills and abilities in familiar and unfamiliar contexts.
Students can apply the principles of lightweight construction in car body development and select suitable materials and joining processes.
Students can integrate new technologies based on the acquired knowledge and derive scientific innovations from them.
Students can convey their ideas to employees and supervisors in discussions and present them plausibly.
Students can assess and evaluate existing and future challenges in car body development.

assessment_methods.method: Term project with milestone and final presentation, and project report (min. 30 pages plus design and calculation data)

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a term-long project work, which includes a milestone and final presentation, as well as a project report of at least 30 pages, supplemented with design and calculation data.
